phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor is the full carrier SIXTEEN_3, the closed boundary containing the entire semantic structure where all orders and negations are defined.

⊢.justification: The initial object is the empty set of supports, representing the state before any affirmation or denial is established.

⊣.justification: The terminal anchor is the complete powerset carrier, the closed boundary that contains all possible subsets and orders.

≻.justification: The forward morphism is the generative re-entry operation, mapping a carrier to its powerset, increasing scale and information.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism is the projection onto the Boolean frame, a descent that loses information by restricting to the classical subalgebra.

⋈.justification: Composition chains the application of negations and orders, such as composing sigma and tau to form the dihedral group actions.

⊙.justification: Self-reference is the identity map on the carrier, or the fixed-point condition where a value equals its negation.

∈.justification: The split opens into the two arms of the negation: the affirmative support (T) and the negative support (F), which are independent coordinates.

∋.justification: The fuse reconstitutes the single Belnap value from the independent supports, where conflicting arms (T and F) fuse to the B state.

⊤.justification: Touches the constructive truth coordinate, establishing that the statement is supported by affirmation.

⊥.justification: Touches the constructive falsity coordinate, establishing that the statement is supported by denial.

⊞.justification: Holds both affirmation and denial simultaneously, the paraconsistent state where a contradiction is kept live without explosion.

⊡.justification: The permanent record of the negation-fixed points {N, B}, which are invariant under the negation operation and form the residue.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: N: Neither affirmation nor denial is supported; the empty state of the carrier.
phase_3.true_description: T: Affirmation is supported without denial; the classical true state.
phase_3.false_description: F: Denial is supported without affirmation; the classical false state.
phase_3.both_description: B: Both affirmation and denial are supported; the paraconsistent glut state.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the void state N, the empty set of supports before any semantic content is named.
Apply the powerset ascent to generate the carrier FOUR from TWO, establishing the Belnap semantic space.
Fork the ambient valuation into its independent coordinates: the affirmative support and the negative support.
Evaluate the affirmative arm, establishing the support for truth in the T coordinate.
Evaluate the negative arm, establishing the support for falsity in the F coordinate.
Fuse the arms back into a single Belnap value, where conflicting supports result in the B state.
Compose the negation operation sigma with the swap operation tau to generate the dihedral group D4.
Assert the identity of the fixed points N and B, which are invariant under the negation operation.
Project the ambient carrier onto the Boolean frame B4, restricting to the classical subalgebra.
Evaluate the failure of the retraction to preserve negation, identifying the defect at the fixed points.
Hold the glut state B, where both the theorem and its negation are designated, maintaining the paraconsistent contradiction.
Record the fixed residue {N, B} as the permanent invariant of the negation operation.
Apply the powerset ascent again to generate SIXTEEN_3 from FOUR, expanding to the trilattice.
Compose the three orders (information, truth, falsity) to define the trilattice structure.
Fork the trilattice into the three independent order structures.
Evaluate the truth order, establishing the lattice structure with complement Delta.
Evaluate the falsity order, establishing the dual lattice structure.
Fuse the orders into the complete trilattice structure, where the complement Delta acts as the Boolean complement.
Anchor the system in the full SIXTEEN_3 carrier, the closed boundary containing all semantic states.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The algebraic compiler translates semantic intentions into lattice operations and negation compositions.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Components communicate via the shared carrier structure, passing Belnap values through the order-preserving embeddings.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: State is stored as subsets of the carrier, with the powerset structure providing the memory hierarchy.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The order of operations is determined by the lattice dependencies, ensuring that negations are applied after supports are established.
phase_5.alfs_store: The canonical reference is the Belnap-Dunn semantic carrier, the primitive object from which all other structures are derived.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The cost per operation cycle is the loss of information when projecting to the Boolean frame, measured by the size of the residue {N, B}.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The system state is the full ambient carrier with all four Belnap values active.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The system state is the restricted Boolean frame, with the paraconsistent states N and B erased or projected.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because the generative re-entry (powerset) exactly compensates for the information loss in the Boolean restriction, maintaining the total semantic capacity.
